**Stable ID:** `DATA-10.03` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 10 Cross-repository integration

Define how accepted dataset records flow to the catalog pipeline for normalization and release.

## Deliverables

- Handoff contract with the catalog pipeline
- Eligibility and rights gates before handoff

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/INTEGRATIONS.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Contract cites the catalog pipeline schema revision

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Only accepted, rights-reviewed records are handed off
- [ ] The contract names versions, formats and owners
- [ ] Catalog maintainers acknowledge the contract

## Non-goals

- Implementing ingestion
